messages:
lisa: FYI customer acme-corp reports ~6h absence of audit events in their SIEM between 2026-03-08 01:40 and 07:50 UTC. Looks like forwarder stopped emitting for tenant acme-corp.
aj: any quick signs? S3 manifests, encryption errors, or throttles?
lisa: forwarder logs show KMS unwrap errors and manifests uploaded as zero-byte. sample:
```
2026-03-08T01:43:12Z ERROR forwarder::encryptor unwrap failed: hsm: signature mismatch
2026-03-08T01:43:12Z WARN forwarder::manifest upload zero-byte s3://audit-archive/acme-corp/2026/03/08/01/manifest-004.gz
```
marc: could be an HSM alias rotation or partial failover. Any HSM alerts?
hsm-bot: ALERT HSM PARTIAL FAILOVER 2026-03-08T01:35 -> 01:50 UTC
lisa: customer saw missing security events and opened compliance case. They need assurance objects weren't deleted and a replay/backfill.
aj: please paste head-object for one manifest and one chunk (include ContentLength, ETag, x-amz-meta-kms-key-id). Also run `aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/acme-hsm` and forwarder pod logs 01:30-02:00.
lisa: pasted trimmed outputs:
HEAD-OBJECT: ContentLength: 0, ETag: "d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e"
CHUNK-HEAD: ContentLength: 612404, x-amz-meta-kms-key-id: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/ef01-2345
forwarder-pod-7b: ERROR decrypt unwrap failed, status=UNWRAP_ERR
forwarder-pod-7b: WARN manifest zero-byte uploaded
aj: describe-key shows KeyState: Enabled, RotationEnabled: true, LastRotation: 2026-03-08T01:30:00Z — suspicious timing. I can validate chunks are intact and attempt a server-side rewrap if policy allows, or run reencrypt replay using last-good wrapping key. Note: if customer requires HSM-signed chaining, rewrap may not meet compliance.
marc: escalate to legal + compliance to confirm signature requirement. I'll also mark the S3 prefix with a retention hold; do not purge anything.
lisa: retention hold applied and batching disabled for acme-corp forwarder to prevent new failures. ingest-bot: INFO batching disabled by lisa at 2026-03-08T02:05:09Z
aj: plan: 1) validate object integrity & KMS metadata (30m) 2) attempt staged rewrap in infra with HSM failover simulation (2-4h) 3) schedule bounded backfill to SIEM with checksums (off-hours) 4) deliver signed incident note after legal confirms
marc: good. aj, paste playbook steps and checksum verification when done. I'll keep the customer briefed via ENG-8345.
lisa: customer acknowledged interim update and asked for ETA. ETA: validate in 30m; backfill 3-6h pending legal.
aj: starting validation now, will report results and attach logs/checksums.
marc: keeping thread open until backfill and compliance sign-off complete.
